# DiveAtlas - Dive Destination Search Engine
DiveAtlas is a structured database of scuba diving destinations worldwide.
Each destination includes visibility, water temperature, best season,
marine life ratings, difficulty level, and budget estimates.

## Core Pages
- /: Homepage with destination finder, interactive map, and browse categories
- /destinations/[slug]: Individual destination guide with diving conditions,
  marine life ratings, best dive spots, pros/cons, and FAQ
- /browse/month/[1-12]: Monthly dive guides with seasonal marine life calendars
- /compare/[slug]: Side-by-side destination comparisons with data tables
- /collections/[slug]: Curated lists (best shark diving, best wrecks, etc.)
- /countries/[slug]: Country-level diving overviews

## Data Model
Each destination has structured data for: visibility (meters),
water temperature (Celsius), current strength, difficulty level,
best months, certification requirements, budget tier, and
marine life ratings for sharks, manta rays, whale sharks, turtles,
coral, macro, and pelagics.
